record.oneLiner: A small, early bipedal ceratopsian with a parrot-like beak.
record.description: Psittacosaurus was a small early ceratopsian from the Early Cretaceous of Asia — a biped with a high skull and a robust parrot-like beak. It is the most species-rich non-avian dinosaur genus and one of the most completely known, from hundreds of individuals. One specimen preserves long bristle-like filaments on the tail.

notableFacts.text: The most species-rich non-avian dinosaur genus — up to 13 species.
One specimen preserves long bristle-like filaments on the tail.
One of the most completely known dinosaurs — hundreds of individuals found.
